description: Daily-news graphics built to read in a feed scroll — the story, in three lines flat.
story: News design is deadline design. Each card had hours, not days: a policy launch broken into numbers, road deaths made legible without being lurid, a quote staged like broadcast. The discipline that survived the pace — one condensed headline voice, one red, the masthead always in the same corner — is what made six graphics from five years look like one newsroom.
